_comment: R7 closure uncertainty matrix. Every item genuinely unresolved as of 2026-09-23, each with the exact experiment that would resolve it and whether that experiment is legitimately available here. status vocabulary: UNKNOWN (no evidence), EXTERNAL_DATA_REQUIRED (needs a real capture/recording), CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED (needs a real Plaud account/partner credential), DEVICE_REQUIRED (needs real Plaud hardware), CLOUD_REQUIRED (needs a live authorized cloud call). can_emulator_assume=false except where noted (U15, U17 and the duplicate U23 carry true after R7-S13): none of these may be promoted to a device fact; the emulator either models them as explicitly-labelled HARNESS_POLICY or leaves them out. Items RESOLVED this session are listed under resolved_this_session for provenance. Updated 2026-09-24 after R7-S13: U19 refined; U15 and U17 updated with runtime facts (U17's Phase-1 rationale corrected); U23 is a duplicate of U15.

unresolved.question: Exact manufacturer-data byte layout of the advertisement, including the portVersion offset and which of u4.a's three branches real hardware takes (was also U18).
unresolved.why_unresolved: u4.a(ScanResult) has three parse branches; only two assign portVersion, and the most serial-number-like layout is the branch that does not. The emulator advertises a self-consistent payload the real SDK parses, but which branch a real device populates is a firmware choice.
evidence_checked: R4-S3/R5-S1 runtime: SDK parsed our synthetic manufacturer data and resolved the product name
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A single BLE scan capture of any Plaud (or other Tinno-based) pen, read passively. No account, no connection.

unresolved.question: Units of free/total/duration in the StorageRsp (opcode 6).
unresolved.why_unresolved: The field offsets/widths/names are DIRECT from n6.<init> and toString, but nothing in the SDK formats the values, so bytes-vs-KB and seconds-vs-ms are unfixed.
evidence_checked: no formatter call site in the SDK
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: One getStorage against real hardware, or a first-party app screen that formats the same values.

unresolved.question: Semantics of the file-list entry `attribute` byte.
unresolved.why_unresolved: q2 parses the byte and getAttribute() exists, but it has zero call sites in the shipped SDK, so no consumer defines its meaning.
evidence_checked: grep for getAttribute call sites: none
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A newer SDK build that consumes it, or a real file-list capture correlated with known file properties.

unresolved.question: Semantics of z2 (GetStateRsp) bytes 16 and 17.
unresolved.why_unresolved: Read into fields with no toString name and no consumer found.
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A real getState correlated with a known device state, or a newer SDK.

unresolved.question: Whether the device honours a non-zero startSessionId or flag in the file-list request p2.
unresolved.why_unresolved: No shipped code sends either as non-zero, so the device-side filtering behaviour is unobserved; the emulator parses but does not filter (POLICY).
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A live experiment issuing p2 with a non-zero start/flag against real hardware.

unresolved.question: The device's 0xFE12 fragment size (how the device chunks the secret package).
unresolved.why_unresolved: The host reassembles any chunking (dedupe+sort+concat), so the device's own fragment size is invisible from the client side.
evidence_checked: R5-S9 synthetic peripheral chunks arbitrarily and the host accepts it
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: One pv>=20 handshake capture from real hardware.

unresolved.question: Whether the device validates the pushed RSA public key / the snSignature.
unresolved.why_unresolved: This is the crux of why binding OUR client to real hardware is blocked: acceptance is the device's decision, and we cannot mint a cloud snSignature. Our emulator accepts by POLICY.
evidence_checked: R7-S12: on pv<20 no key/signature is involved at all
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: Push a self-generated key with a genuine cloud snSignature to real hardware — requires both a device and a credential; deliberately not attempted.

unresolved.question: Semantics of the constant 0x02 at k3 offset 3, and of z.h() (stubbed to 0).
unresolved.why_unresolved: k3 writes 0x02 unconditionally and z.h() returns a hard 0 in this build; no reader on the device side is visible, and the value was 0x02/0 in every runtime capture (R7-S12) so no variation was observed to constrain the meaning.
evidence_checked: R7-S12 runs 1/3/4 all show 02 00 at offsets 3-4
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: An older SDK build where z.h() is non-trivial, or the iOS encoder, or a device that rejects a wrong constant.

unresolved.question: Device-side MTU acceptance and whether it enforces receive-sequence monotonicity on the sealed path.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The client requests MTU 255 (negotiated to 517 on the AVD); what a real device grants, and whether it drops out-of-order sealed frames, is device behaviour.
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: Real hardware.

unresolved.question: Device-side effect of isForceClear (0xFE20 vs 0xFE10).
unresolved.why_unresolved: Host-side accumulator behaviour is known; the firmware effect of a force-clear is not. On pv<20 the flag is inert (R7-S12 confirmed no marker is written), so it can only be observed on a pv>=20 device.
evidence_checked: R7-S12: recovery sets isForceClear=true, no FE20 written on pv 7
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A pv>=20 device connected via the recovery path.

unresolved.question: c5.start (resume record response) — byte offset or timestamp?
unresolved.why_unresolved: The field is parsed but has no consumer in the Android code to disambiguate its units.
evidence_checked: no consumer of the start field
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A real resume-record exchange correlated with a known transfer position.

unresolved.question: Whether the device emits file-list frames strictly in index order.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The client has no gap recovery for the file list, so ordering matters, but the device's emission order is a firmware behaviour.
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: An air capture of a multi-page file list.

unresolved.question: What the transfer-tail CRC (t6) covers.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The SDK stores and stringifies the u16 CRC but never verifies it; no tntGetCrc/tntGetFileCrc call site consumes it, so its coverage is undefined from the client side.
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A real transfer whose tail CRC can be checked against candidate coverages of the delivered bytes.

unresolved.question: Whether y6's `end` is inclusive or exclusive, and whether end==0 formally means EOF.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The client sends end and never consumes it in the gap logic; the device defines its meaning. Every observed call site sends 0.
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: Issue y6 with end=start+N against real hardware and count delivered bytes.

unresolved.question: EMPTY_PACKAGE code values other than 1.
unresolved.why_unresolved: Client side now known (bytecode + R7-S13 runtime): with no recovery in flight any code completes the sync; during a recovery code 1 is ignored and other codes trigger a restart; codes 0 and 1 both completed live (runs 4b, 8). What real firmware sends, and why, is still unknown. The emulator sends 0 (HARNESS_POLICY).
evidence_checked: q$a EMPTY_PACKAGE code read at i+5
R7-S13 runs 4b (code 0) and 8 (code 1): real SDK completes byte-exact on both
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A real end-of-transfer sequence.

unresolved.question: s6 (HEAD) status values beyond 'non-zero is an error'.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The client treats any status>0 as failure without distinguishing codes.
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: Request a non-existent session, an out-of-range start, and a busy device against real hardware.

unresolved.question: Whether the device emits the TAIL before, after, or instead of an EMPTY_PACKAGE at end-of-file.
unresolved.why_unresolved: CORRECTED 2026-09-24. The Phase-1 wording ('both terminate a transfer through independent callbacks and nothing in the client orders them') was wrong for the client: at runtime the TAIL never completed the sync, only the EMPTY_PACKAGE did, and an EMPTY_PACKAGE sent after the TAIL was never acted on (R7-S13 runs 1/2/9 vs 4b/8 vs 7). So a device that works with the SDK must send EMPTY_PACKAGE before the TAIL. Whether real firmware also sends the TAIL, or sends EMPTY_PACKAGE alone, is still unknown.
evidence_checked: q$a terminal paths for TAIL and EMPTY_PACKAGE
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: One clean end-to-end transfer capture.

unresolved.question: Cloud-exported audio vs the local SDK writer: real downloads carry OpusTags vendor 'PALUD.AI' while libjni_ogg.so writes 'TinnoTech123456789012' — does the cloud transcode or only re-tag?
unresolved.why_unresolved: 'PALUD.AI' appears nowhere in the SDK native library across all four ABIs, and R7-S13 (2026-09-24) showed the local SDK's AudioExportFormat.OPUS export of a plain-Ogg recording is a byte-exact passthrough (OpusTags vendor untouched, no re-encode), so neither local path can produce the cloud's tag: the cloud re-encodes/re-tags server-side; the exact transform is only visible in a real download.
evidence_checked: riffado regression #160: real download OpusTags = PALUD.AI, .mp3 filename, Ogg/Opus bytes
R7-S13 run 4b/8/10: exportAudio(OPUS) output sha256 == served fixture sha256 (r7/r7-s13-evidence/SHA256SUMS)
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: One lawfully obtained download from an account the operator owns, byte-compared against a device-written file.

unresolved.question: Which of the four closed recording shapes ({plain, PLAUD.AI-encrypted} x {Ogg, raw Opus}) real firmware emits over BLE, and whether the 512-byte header is present on the BLE path.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The format-SELECTION chain is fully closed by bytecode (512-byte PLAUD.AI magic test, then 4-byte OggS sniff; isOggAudio is written but never read). Which shape a device actually sends is a firmware choice not present in any shipped artifact.
evidence_checked: o4 pass-through so DATA payloads == stored file
R6-S3 whole-worktree sweep: zero authentic Plaud audio present
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: One authentic Plaud BLE file-transfer capture; run classify on the concatenated DATA payloads.

unresolved.question: The absolute host of the legacy TntAgent endpoints /recorder/device/{checkSn,checkCustomer,saveOperation}.
unresolved.why_unresolved: r3 declares the path constants but the builder shows an empty host prefix; the base URL is assembled elsewhere and no literal host was found in r3/q3/p7.
evidence_checked: query-signature auth with a hard-coded secret
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: Static: trace r3.b(String) callers / the base-url provider. The endpoint must never be exercised (production, hard-coded secret, issues real tokens).

unresolved.question: Which capability bits (opcode 138) and which CommonSettings values (opcode 8) real firmware reports.
unresolved.why_unresolved: Both channels are fully implemented and their layouts proven, but the VALUES a real device returns are firmware state. Only opcode-138 bit 3 has a recovered consumer; seven bits have no reader.
evidence_checked: R7-S12 run 4: the SDK read ENABLE_VAD and REC_MODE
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: Any real-device session log.

unresolved.question: FE11 live payload bytes and FE20 device-side effect (R5-S11 UNKNOWN set).
unresolved.why_unresolved: The host reads only the u16 marker of FE11 and dispatches; the payload after the marker is never parsed, and FE20's firmware effect is unobserved (host-side accumulator behaviour only).
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A pv>=20 handshake capture from real hardware.

unresolved.question: Device sealed-TX start value and device ACK/chunk-ACK timing on the sealed path.
unresolved.why_unresolved: The host's first sealed sequence is 2 (proven); the device's own first TX value and any ACK timing are device state. R5-S8 modelled independent M/N counters synthetically.
evidence_checked: no transport ACK on the host side
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A real pv>=20 sealed session.

unresolved.question: Real credential values: the handshake token, the cloud snSignature, and the RSA key pair.
unresolved.why_unresolved: These are minted by Plaud's cloud (gen-key returns the private key; sn-sign returns the signature) against a partner userAccessToken. None exists in the repository and none can be produced offline. This is the single structural blocker for binding OUR client to real hardware.
evidence_checked: R4-S4 credential provenance: placeholders only, no test-credential mechanism
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: A real Plaud partner account. Deliberately not attempted; using one would still not make the result evidence about the protocol, only about that account.

unresolved.question: Which EMPTY_PACKAGE code value(s) real firmware sends to close a transfer, and what they mean (0 vs 1 vs other)?
unresolved.why_unresolved: Registered on 2026-09-24 before noticing U15 already asks this. Kept only so existing references resolve; tracked under U15 (code values) and U17 (ordering).
evidence_checked: R7-S13 runs 4b (code 0) and 8 (code 1): both complete byte-exact; runs 1/2/9 (no sentinel) and 7 (after TAIL) never complete
unresolved.legitimate_next_evidence: One BLE capture of a real device finishing a transfer (any pv < 20 unit) shows the code byte.
unresolved.emulator_assumption: EMPTY_PACKAGE(code 0) before TAIL; configurable via TransferSession.empty_package_code

resolved_this_session.was: PARTIAL — modern handshake blocked; k3 token value cloud-issued
resolved_this_session.now: k3 CONSTRUCTION is SDK_PROVEN+BYTECODE_PROVEN+RUNTIME_PROVEN+EMULATOR_INTEGRATION_PROVEN via recoveryConnectBleDevice with a synthetic id on the pv<20 path; only the token VALUE for a real bind stays CRED-1
CommonSettings channel fully resolved (q0/r0 layout, 21-entry non-ordinal CommonType table, consumer q.f), implemented and RUNTIME_PROVEN for the two READs

BYTECODE_PROVEN client behaviour: gap → restart-from-cursor; stopSync sent at once on a gap, then restart from the cursor (corrected 25 Sep from the R7-S13 runtime runs; the 5 s timer is the stall path); no ACK, no NAK; device performs neither

resolved_this_session.was: AES-GCM listed as a generic BLE alternate
resolved_this_session.now: BLE is always ChaCha20-Poly1305; AES-GCM is Wi-Fi-only (opcode-138 bit 3)
sniff-based (512-byte PLAUD.AI magic then OggS); isOggAudio written-but-never-read — BYTECODE_PROVEN, pinned by a falsification test
resolved_this_session.evidence: tests/test_r7_s12_audio_selection_pin.py; U20 is the only residual (external)

resolved_this_session.was: bleBind protVersion=0 looked like an emulator gap
resolved_this_session.now: facade forwards q.n = the l3 timezone byte as BOTH protVersion and timezone; RUNTIME_PROVEN (l3 tz=5 ⇒ protVersion=5)
